summary: Fixed a smoke test that broke the next test at random, made Analytics tabs follow in-page links and Back, and gave planned uploads a hollow dot on the Calendar so phones show them apart from scheduled without relying on colour.
why: The smoke run failed 1 of 96 because a mocked API was still fetching after its test ended. The other two were open backlog items whose 7-day wait had ended (Analytics touched 11-03, Calendar 11-04).

findings.title: Mocked routes leaked across smoke tests
findings.detail: route.fetch threw 'Test ended' in the following test; fixed with an afterEach unrouteAll.

changes.title: Smoke tests drop in-flight routes after each test
Analytics: tab follows the URL hash
Calendar: hollow dot for planned uploads
changes.detail: shape, not colour alone; new smoke test
